name: cloudcodex-environment-discovery
description: Read-only provider-specific discovery of Codex Cloud Legacy and current environments, with two independent skills and no implicit mixed catalogs.

interface.longDescription: Independent read-only Legacy and Current Codex Cloud discovery. Two independently discoverable skills (legacy-discovery and current-discovery), separate provider adapters and explicit domain-specific tools. ChatGPT Root selects the requested generation directly, with no mandatory Root skill or mixed catalog. No task/environment creation, no credential extraction; live reads require authorized channels.
interface.defaultPrompt: Determine the requested Codex Cloud type first. For Legacy invoke $legacy-discovery; for current-generation Cloud invoke $current-discovery. If both are explicitly requested, invoke the two skills separately and report separate provider statuses; do not produce an implicit mixed catalog. Read-only: no task or environment creation. On missing authorization, report unavailable instead of empty.
